# `Q-5-60` — Data URI Social Image Ignored

> A social media preview image is a data URI, which social media sites can't fetch; it is ignored.

## What this means

`og:image` and `twitter:image` tell social media sites where to fetch
a page's preview image. A data URI (`data:image/png;base64,...`) puts
the image inside the page instead of at a URL, and those sites don't
read it.

Quarto ignores the data URI and looks for another preview image: an
image in the page body, then `website.image`.

## Why this happens

The page's `image:`, or an `image` option under `open-graph` /
`twitter-card` or `website.image`, is a data URI.

## How to fix

Save the image as a file in the project and point at the file:

```yaml
---
title: My Post
image: cover.png
---
```
